title: VDOM Reconciliation: Render, Diff & Commit
description: Step through how O(n) heuristic tree diffing turns a state update into minimal DOM patches.

steps.label: 1. Render Phase (Pure JS Tree)
steps.description: Component returns a new JS descriptor tree. Zero live DOM nodes are touched yet.

steps.label: 2. Reconcile & Keyed List Match
steps.description: Diff compares element.type and key. Same type+key updates props; changed type unmounts subtree.
steps.codeHighlight: // key='row-7' matched at index 0 -> move node, preserve <input> state

steps.label: 3. Commit Phase (Batched DOM Patch)
steps.description: Engine applies only the 2 changed attributes/moves in one synchronous commit pass.
